description: Your Loom library as a local, searchable archive: grep what you said, back up everything, and recap a week in one command.

loom_cookie.title: Loom session cookie
loom_cookie.description: The connect.sid session cookie the Loom web app uses (valid about 30 days). Import it with auth login --chrome while signed in to loom.com, or set LOOM_COOKIE to 'connect.sid=<value>'.
